scope: 20 replacement appearances: six partial comparisons to inspected official product images and fourteen technical repairs. 51 selectable costumes and 179 archive identities remain unchanged.

generation.method: Five new RGBA sheets generated using inspected project images and targeted visual instructions. Original PNGs remain unmodified. Individual source rectangles and, where needed, the largest connected component are selected by the shared renderer.
constraints: Keep the complete silhouette and clear outer margins.
Use real native alpha rather than a painted checkerboard or black background.
Preserve opaque dark bodies and translucent Bubble material independently.
Do not infer new episode appearances or certify canonical proportions from merchandise.

resolvedIssues: Socle de pierres et d’herbe entraîné pendant les déplacements.

visibleTraits: Tête de rhinocéros gris clair, corne, chapeau de safari et gilet beige.
Corps et membres en rubans rouges, sans socle, pierre ni herbe attachés.
assetReview.identityEvidence: Le corps en rubans rattache ce dessin à Gangle ; la tête de rhinocéros ne prouve pas à elle seule une transformation de la série.
assetReview.framing: Rectangle individuel de la nouvelle planche 0.6.0, indépendant de sa grille indicative. Le personnage entier est contrôlé dans la garde-robe et en combat ; les apparences historiques restent archivées.
assetReview.transparency: Alpha natif de la nouvelle image 0.6.0 conservé, y compris les ouvertures entre membres. Aucun détourage par couleur noire ou blanche et aucun fond quadrillé à retirer.
assetReview.proportions: Dessin : Tête de rhinocéros large sur une spirale étroite et libre de rubans rouges. Affichage : mise à l’échelle uniforme du cadre extrait ; le portrait et la pose de combat sont contrôlés séparément. Aucune proportion canonique mesurée.
resolvedIssues: Socle de pierres et d’herbe entraîné pendant les déplacements.

resolvedIssues: Remplissage violet opaque et ombre au sol inclus dans l’ancien dessin.

browserEvidence.scope: Twenty wardrobe-to-training flows with an accepted keyboard attack, not twenty completed duel results.

checks.name: All 20 replacement sprites have real transparent margins and complete extraction bounds
checks.detail: Native-alpha portraits loaded through the shipped renderer; no visible pixel touches any extracted outer edge.

checks.name: All seven Shadow bodies retain solid black pixels without opaque atlas rectangles
checks.detail: Every extracted Shadow figure has substantial opaque black body area and clear surrounding alpha.

checks.name: Queen and adjacent horror cells isolate the complete intended component
checks.detail: Queen preserves its 529px body while excluding the neighboring rhinoceros fragment; both close horror cells keep their complete bodies.

checks.name: Bubble uses partial native alpha while retaining readable dark eyes
checks.detail: Most visible sphere pixels are translucent; eyes remain opaque enough to survive light and dark stages.

checks.name: Six primary-reference costumes expose the corrected detail review in their real wardrobe
checks.detail: All six keep their partial comparison label, source links and limits; captured previews use the new art.

checks.name: All 20 refined costumes launch actual training and accept a real keyboard attack
checks.detail: Wardrobe → Try appearance → fight was executed for every replacement; browsing/training does not award progress or change the profile.

checks.name: Refined costume preview fits the 390px wardrobe and preserves selection after Escape
checks.detail: Viewport layout and keyboard closure checked; no claim about a physical phone.

checks.name: Refined costume flows produce no browser or local asset errors
checks.detail: All five generated PNG sheets and the new module loaded successfully.

contactSheet.method: Screenshot montage of the twenty actual renderer extracts; checkerboard is the review page background only.

limits: Canonical 1:1 fidelity remains unverified. Six primary comparisons cover visible costume details, not every angle, expression, proportion or episode.
Fourteen technical repairs do not create new canonical source evidence for Shadow, Horror, Hunter or other archive variants.
Generated pixel-art contours and poses differ from both the previous illustrations and official 3D/product imagery.
Gloink Queen True Scale remains an inherited archive label, not a measured canonical size.
These are whole-character illustrations with procedural combat transforms, not newly authored attack animation cells.
No physical phone or gamepad validation is implied by Chromium tests.
